extra_vocab.en: the money you pay to travel by plane
extra_vocab.note: 多益常出現在出差、差旅報銷與訂票的情境，例如公司是否負擔 airfare、比較不同航班的價格。常和 hotel、accommodation 一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 泛指機票費用時，airfare 多半當不可數名詞，不加 a；比較不同航班的票價時才用複數 airfares。

example.en: Airfares to Tokyo rise sharply during the holiday season.
example.zh: 假期期間飛往東京的機票價格會大幅上漲。

example.en: The company will pay for airfare and hotel costs.
example.zh: 公司會支付機票與飯店費用。

example.en: Please keep your receipts so we can reimburse your airfare.
example.zh: 請保留收據，我們才能報銷你的機票費用。

example.en: Booking early usually gets you a lower airfare.
example.zh: 提早訂票通常可以拿到比較便宜的機票。

example.en: The grant covers airfare and accommodation for all speakers.
example.zh: 這筆補助涵蓋所有講者的機票與住宿。

examples.en: Airfare is the biggest part of our travel budget this year.
examples.zh: 機票費用是我們今年差旅預算中最大的一塊。

examples.en: The airfare to Singapore is about five hundred dollars.
examples.zh: 飛往新加坡的機票大約是五百美元。

examples.en: Employees must submit airfare receipts within seven days of returning.
examples.zh: 員工必須在回國後七天內提交機票收據。

examples.en: The invitation says the host will cover your airfare.
examples.zh: 邀請函上說主辦單位會負擔你的機票費用。

confusable.diff: fare 是各種交通工具的車資、票價；airfare 專指搭飛機的費用。

example.en: The bus fare to the airport is only five dollars.
example.zh: 到機場的公車車資只要五美元。

confusable.diff: fair 和 airfare 的後半部同音，意思是「展覽會」或「公平的」，與機票無關。

example.en: Our company will attend the job fair in Taipei next week.
example.zh: 我們公司下週會參加台北的就業博覽會。

similar.diff: plane ticket 是機票本身（實體或電子）；airfare 是購買機票所花的費用。

example.en: Please email me the plane ticket once you pay.
example.zh: 付款後請把機票用電子郵件寄給我。

example.en: I need to buy a train ticket for tomorrow.
example.zh: 我需要買一張明天的火車票。

example.en: Please check the itinerary before you leave for the trip.
example.zh: 出發前請先確認行程表。

example.en: You can ask for reimbursement after the business trip.
example.zh: 出差結束後你可以申請報銷。

extra_vocab.en: happening one after another, or used in place of another thing
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見的形容詞（alternate route 替代路線、alternate days 隔天）與動詞（輪流）。公告改道、輪班排程、備用方案時很常出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: alternate 當形容詞與名詞時字尾唸 /ət/，當動詞時唸 /eɪt/；動詞後面常接 between A and B 或 with。

example.en: This printer alternates between two paper trays automatically.
example.zh: 這台印表機會自動在兩個紙匣之間輪流取紙。

example.en: We alternated between the two suppliers to reduce risk.
example.zh: 我們輪流向兩家供應商下單以降低風險。

example.en: The team is alternating weekend duty this month.
example.zh: 這個月團隊正輪流值週末班。

example.en: Drivers should take an alternate route because of road work.
example.zh: 因為道路施工，駕駛人應改走替代路線。

collocations.zh: 在 A 與 B 之間輪流

example.en: Our managers alternate between working at home and in the office.
example.zh: 我們的經理輪流在家和在辦公室工作。

example.en: The cleaning crew visits the office on alternate days.
example.zh: 清潔人員每隔一天來辦公室一次。

example.en: We need an alternate plan in case the supplier is late.
example.zh: 萬一供應商延遲，我們需要一個備用計畫。

examples.en: Please use the alternate entrance while the main door is repaired.
examples.zh: 主要大門維修期間，請使用另一個入口。

examples.en: The two teams alternate Saturdays, so everyone gets a weekend off.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊輪流值週六班，所以每個人都有週末可以休息。

examples.en: We booked an alternate flight when ours was cancelled.
examples.zh: 我們原本的班機被取消後，我們改訂了另一班飛機。

confusable.diff: alternative 常指「可選擇的另一個方案」，不含「輪流」的意思。
confusable.usage: alternate 當形容詞指「替代的」或「輪流的」，也可以當動詞；alternative 多當名詞（可選方案）或形容詞（另一種可選的）。

example.en: We need an alternative to our current shipping company.
example.zh: 我們需要一個可以取代目前貨運公司的選擇。

similar.diff: backup 強調預先準備、出問題時才使用；alternate 常用於替代的路線、時間、地點。

example.en: We have a backup generator in case the power fails.
example.zh: 我們有備用發電機以防停電。

example.en: A substitute will cover the class while he is away.
example.zh: 他不在時會有代課老師接手這堂課。

example.en: Staff rotate between the day and night shifts.
example.zh: 員工在日班與夜班之間輪替。

example.en: Cancelling the trip is not an option for us.
example.zh: 取消旅程對我們來說不是一個選項。

derived.link: alternate 去掉 e 加 -ion，輪流這個動作，像 decoration、creation

example.en: Customers can pick up orders at an alternate location.
example.zh: 顧客可以到另一個地點領取訂單。

example.en: Sales and service teams alternate in handling weekend calls.
example.zh: 業務與客服團隊輪流處理週末來電。

example.en: Each committee member must name an alternate.
example.zh: 每位委員都必須指定一位代理人。

senses.en: used in place of another thing

example.en: Please call the alternate number if nobody answers the main line.
example.zh: 如果主線沒人接，請撥打備用號碼。

senses.en: every second one, or one after the other
senses.distinguish: 出現 days、weeks、Saturdays 等時間詞時，通常指「隔一個」。

example.en: The bus runs on alternate Sundays during the winter months.
example.zh: 冬季期間這條公車路線每隔一個星期日行駛。

extra_vocab.en: wanting very much to succeed, or needing a lot of effort to achieve
extra_vocab.note: 多益常用來形容人（有企圖心的員工）或計畫與目標（規模大、不容易達成）。語氣多半是正面的。

example.en: The CEO announced an ambitious plan to open ten new stores.
example.zh: 執行長宣布了開設十家新店的宏大計畫。

example.en: Our team set an ambitious goal for next quarter's sales.
example.zh: 我們團隊為下一季的銷售訂下了一個高目標。

example.en: She is highly ambitious and hopes to lead the department soon.
example.zh: 她非常有野心，希望不久後能領導這個部門。

example.en: The ambitious project will take three years to finish.
example.zh: 這個大型專案需要三年才能完成。

examples.en: We are looking for an ambitious sales manager to join our team.
examples.zh: 我們正在尋找有企圖心的業務經理加入團隊。

examples.en: That target sounds ambitious, but I think we can reach it.
examples.zh: 那個目標聽起來很有挑戰性，但我認為我們做得到。

examples.en: His ambitious attitude helped him earn a promotion in two years.
examples.zh: 他積極進取的態度讓他在兩年內獲得升遷。

examples.en: The company has an ambitious schedule for launching its new app.
examples.zh: 這家公司為推出新應用程式訂了一個很緊湊的時程。

confusable.diff: ambiguous 是「模糊不清、有多種解釋的」；ambitious 是「有野心的」，只是開頭相似。

example.en: The contract wording is ambiguous, so please ask the lawyer.
example.zh: 合約的用字很模糊，請去問律師。

similar.diff: determined 強調下定決心要做到某事，不一定有遠大的目標。

example.en: She is determined to finish the report before Friday.
example.zh: 她下定決心要在星期五前完成報告。

similar.diff: driven 強調內在動力很強、做事很拚，語氣比較口語。

example.en: He is a driven worker who never misses a deadline.
example.zh: 他是個很有衝勁的員工，從不錯過截止日期。

example.en: Our goal is to double sales this year.
example.zh: 我們的目標是今年讓銷售額加倍。

example.en: The sales team met its monthly target.
example.zh: 業務團隊達成了當月的指標。

example.en: She received a promotion after the successful launch.
example.zh: 成功上市後她獲得了升遷。

derived.link: ambitious 的詞幹，「野心」；去掉 -ious 換成 -ion，像 action、decision
un- + ambitious，加 un- 表示相反，像 unhappy、unable

senses.en: wanting very much to be successful, rich, or powerful
senses.distinguish: 修飾人時，指「有企圖心、想往上爬」。

example.en: The ambitious young engineer asked for more responsibility.
example.zh: 那位有企圖心的年輕工程師要求承擔更多責任。

senses.zh: 規模大、不容易達成的（形容計畫）
senses.en: big and hard to do, but still possible
senses.distinguish: 修飾 plan、goal、schedule 等事物時，指「規模大、難度高」。

example.en: They made an ambitious promise to cut costs by half.
example.zh: 他們做出了把成本減半的高難度承諾。

extra_vocab.en: again, in a new and different way
extra_vocab.note: 較正式的副詞，多益常見於公司重整、重新開始計畫等情境。位置通常放在句尾，如 start anew。

example.en: After the merger, the team had to start anew.
example.zh: 合併之後，團隊必須重新開始。

example.en: The company decided to begin anew with a fresh strategy.
example.zh: 公司決定以全新的策略重新出發。

example.en: They plan to build the old warehouse anew after the fire.
example.zh: 火災之後，他們打算把舊倉庫重新蓋起來。

examples.en: The manager asked us to write the proposal anew.
examples.zh: 經理要求我們重新撰寫這份提案。

examples.en: She left her job and tried her luck anew in another city.
examples.zh: 她離開工作，到另一個城市重新闖蕩。

examples.en: Let us look at the budget anew before we make a decision.
examples.zh: 在做決定之前，讓我們重新檢視預算。

confusable.diff: a new 是「冠詞＋形容詞」，意思是「一個新的…」，後面一定接名詞。
confusable.usage: anew 是副詞，用來修飾動詞（start anew）；a new 後面一定要接名詞（a new plan）。

example.en: We need a new supplier because our old one closed.
example.zh: 我們需要一家新的供應商，因為舊的那家倒閉了。

similar.diff: again 最常用，只表示「再一次」；anew 強調用新的方式重新開始，較正式。

example.en: Please check the figures again before you send them.
example.zh: 寄出之前請再檢查一次這些數字。

similar.diff: from scratch 是「從零開始、完全不用舊的」；anew 不一定要丟掉舊的東西。

example.en: We decided to design the website from scratch.
example.zh: 我們決定從零開始設計這個網站。

example.en: Please restart the computer after the update.
example.zh: 更新之後請重新啟動電腦。

example.en: We need fresh ideas for the next campaign.
example.zh: 我們需要為下一個活動想出全新的點子。

derived.link: anew 的詞幹，a- + new，意思是「重新」
new + -ly，新近地，像 newly hired（新進的）
re-（再一次）+ new，讓它再新一次，像 redo、restart

extra_vocab.en: words you say to show you are sorry
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於客訴回覆、延誤公告與電子郵件，如 Please accept our apologies。語氣正式有禮。重音在第二音節。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: apology 後面接 for + 名詞或 V-ing（an apology for the delay）；道歉的對象用 to（an apology to our customers）。「道歉」的動詞搭配是 make an apology，不用 do。

example.en: We sent our sincere apologies to every customer affected by the delay.
example.zh: 我們向每一位受延誤影響的顧客致上誠摯的歉意。

example.en: The manager made a public apology for the mistake.
example.zh: 經理為這個錯誤公開道歉。

example.en: I will accept your apology if the problem is fixed today.
example.zh: 如果問題今天修好，我就接受你的道歉。

example.en: I think we owe our clients an apology for the delay.
example.zh: 我認為我們應該為延誤向客戶道歉。

example.en: The airline issued a formal apology to all passengers.
example.zh: 航空公司向所有乘客發出正式的道歉。

examples.en: I would like to offer my sincere apology for the mix-up.
examples.zh: 對於這次的混淆，我想致上誠摯的歉意。

examples.en: My apologies for the late reply; I was traveling last week.
examples.zh: 很抱歉這麼晚才回覆，我上週在出差。

examples.en: An apology appeared on the company website after the system error.
examples.zh: 系統出錯後，公司網站上刊出了一則道歉聲明。

examples.en: The store gave her a refund along with a short apology.
examples.zh: 商店退款給她，並附上一句簡短的道歉。

confusable.diff: excuse 是「藉口、理由」，用來解釋為什麼；apology 是「道歉」，表達歉意。

example.en: His excuse for being late was not accepted by the manager.
example.zh: 他遲到的藉口沒有被經理接受。

similar.diff: regret 較正式，常用在公文或公告；apology 更通用，也可以是當面說出口的道歉。

example.en: We express our regret for any trouble caused by the delay.
example.zh: 對於延誤所造成的任何不便，我們深表遺憾。

example.en: The company received many complaints about the slow service.
example.zh: 公司收到許多關於服務太慢的客訴。

example.en: You can ask for a full refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 你可以在三十天內申請全額退款。

derived.link: apology 去掉 -y 加 -ize，變成動詞「道歉」，像 organize、realize

derived.zh: 感到抱歉的、表示歉意的
derived.link: apology 的形容詞形式，字尾 -tic，意思是「帶著歉意的」

extra_vocab.en: a feeling of being thankful, or an understanding of how good something is
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於感謝信、頒獎與員工表揚，如 in appreciation of your hard work。在財務情境也可指資產價值上升。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: appreciation 表示感謝時是不可數名詞，不加 s，後面常接 for + 事物（appreciation for your help）；表達對象用 to。

example.en: We would like to express our appreciation for your support.
example.zh: 我們想對您的支持表達感謝。

example.en: The company held a dinner to show its appreciation to staff.
example.zh: 公司舉辦晚宴向員工表達感謝。

example.en: This gift is given in appreciation of your ten years of service.
example.zh: 這份禮物是為了感謝您十年來的服務。

example.en: Please take this small gift as a token of appreciation.
example.zh: 請收下這份小禮物，作為我們的一點心意。

examples.en: My appreciation goes to everyone who worked late to finish the report.
examples.zh: 我要感謝每一位為了完成報告而加班的人。

examples.en: Home price appreciation was about five percent last year.
examples.zh: 去年房價大約上漲了百分之五。

examples.en: Her appreciation of good design helped the team choose the logo.
examples.zh: 她對好設計的鑑賞力幫助團隊選出了標誌。

confusable.diff: appraisal 是「評估、鑑價」，常指專業人士判斷價值；appreciation 是「感謝」或「價值上升」。

example.en: A professional appraisal showed the building was worth more than expected.
example.zh: 專業鑑價顯示這棟建築的價值比預期高。

similar.diff: gratitude 偏向內心的感激之情；appreciation 更常用在正式、商務的感謝表達。

example.en: He showed his gratitude by sending flowers to the whole team.
example.zh: 他送花給整個團隊來表達感激。

similar.diff: thanks 比較口語，可以用複數形式；appreciation 較正式。

example.en: Many thanks for your quick reply.
example.zh: 非常感謝你迅速回覆。

example.en: She won recognition for her excellent customer service.
example.zh: 她因為優異的客戶服務而獲得肯定。

example.en: The value of the land has risen quickly.
example.zh: 這塊土地的價值上升得很快。

derived.link: appreciation 的詞幹，動詞「感激」；-ate 結尾，像 create、celebrate
appreciate + -ive，表示「懷有感激之情的」，像 active、creative

derived.zh: 沒被重視的、未被感激的
derived.link: un- + appreciated，加 un- 表示相反，像 unhappy、unable

example.en: The staff showed great appreciation for the extra day off.
example.zh: 員工對多出來的一天假表達了十分的感謝。

senses.en: an increase in value over time
senses.distinguish: 與房地產、貨幣、股票等一起出現時，指價值上漲。

example.en: The appreciation of the euro made imports cheaper for us.
example.zh: 歐元升值讓我們的進口品變得比較便宜。

senses.en: the ability to understand and enjoy something good
senses.distinguish: 後面接 of + 藝術、文化、品質時，指「欣賞、理解」。

example.en: A good appreciation of local culture helps in overseas sales.
example.zh: 對當地文化有良好的理解有助於海外銷售。

extra_vocab.en: a curved line, like part of a circle
extra_vocab.note: 多益中較少見，常出現在建築、設計、產品描述或圖表說明中，如 the arc of the roof。也可比喻發展的軌跡，如 career arc。

example.en: The designer drew two arcs on the chart to show growth.
example.zh: 設計師在圖表上畫了兩條弧線來表示成長。

example.en: The water from the fountain rises in an arc.
example.zh: 噴泉的水呈弧形向上噴出。

example.en: The seats form an arc around the stage.
example.zh: 座位在舞台周圍排成弧形。

example.en: Her career arc shows steady growth over twenty years.
example.zh: 她的職涯軌跡顯示二十年來穩定成長。

examples.en: The new bridge has a graceful arc over the river.
examples.zh: 這座新橋在河上有著優美的弧形。

examples.en: The logo uses a simple arc to suggest a smile.
examples.zh: 這個標誌用一道簡單的弧線來暗示微笑。

examples.en: The arc of the project went from a slow start to a strong finish.
examples.zh: 這個專案的走勢從緩慢起步到強勢收尾。

confusable.diff: ark 和 arc 完全同音，意思是「方舟」，與弧線無關。

example.en: The museum has a small model of Noah's ark.
example.zh: 博物館有一個諾亞方舟的小模型。

confusable.diff: arch 是「拱門、拱形結構」；arc 是一段圓弧的線條。

example.en: Customers walk through a stone arch to enter the market.
example.zh: 顧客穿過一道石拱門進入市場。

similar.diff: curve 更常用，泛指任何曲線；arc 指圓的一段，比較精確。

example.en: There is a sharp curve on the road near the factory.
example.zh: 工廠附近的路上有一個急轉彎。

example.en: Please draw a circle around the correct answer.
example.zh: 請在正確答案周圍畫一個圈。

example.en: The sales curve is going up this quarter.
example.zh: 本季的銷售曲線正在上升。

example.en: The new table has an unusual shape.
example.zh: 這張新桌子的形狀很特別。

extra_vocab.zh: 藝術的；有藝術天分的；有美感的
extra_vocab.en: related to art, or showing skill in making beautiful things
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於設計、廣告、展覽與徵才情境，如 artistic director、artistic design。語氣正面，形容人有美感或作品有創意。

example.en: He has real artistic talent and designs all our posters.
example.zh: 他有真正的藝術天分，我們所有的海報都由他設計。

example.en: The artistic director chose the music for the festival.
example.zh: 藝術總監挑選了音樂節的曲目。

example.en: The hotel is famous for its artistic design.
example.zh: 這家飯店以其藝術設計聞名。

example.en: Her artistic style is simple and modern.
example.zh: 她的藝術風格簡潔又現代。

examples.en: We need someone artistic to help with the packaging of our new products.
examples.zh: 我們需要有美感的人來協助新產品的包裝。

examples.en: The gallery will hold an artistic event for local students on Friday.
examples.zh: 畫廊星期五將為當地學生舉辦一場藝術活動。

examples.en: The artistic quality of the brochure impressed every customer.
examples.zh: 這本小冊子的藝術水準讓每位顧客都印象深刻。

confusable.diff: artificial 是「人造的、不自然的」；artistic 是「藝術的」，兩者開頭相似。

example.en: The juice contains no artificial colors or flavors.
example.zh: 這款果汁不含人工色素或香料。

similar.diff: creative 強調「有創意、點子多」；artistic 強調「有美感與藝術技巧」。

example.en: We want a creative team to write the advertising slogan.
example.zh: 我們想請一個有創意的團隊來撰寫廣告標語。

example.en: The design of the new phone is very simple.
example.zh: 這款新手機的設計非常簡潔。

example.en: The gallery opens at ten every morning.
example.zh: 這間畫廊每天早上十點開門。

example.en: We hired a talented designer last month.
example.zh: 我們上個月僱用了一位有才華的設計師。

example.en: The company hired an artistic consultant for its new store.
example.zh: 公司為新店聘請了一位藝術顧問。

senses.zh: 有美感的、有藝術天分的
senses.en: having a good sense of beauty and style
senses.distinguish: 形容人有天分、或作品很有美感時用這個意思。

example.en: Her artistic eye made the window display attractive.
example.zh: 她的藝術眼光讓櫥窗展示很吸引人。

extra_vocab.en: a lawyer, especially in the United States
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於合約、法律諮詢與商務糾紛情境。美式英語中 attorney 指有執照的律師，常和 contract、lawsuit 一起出現。

example.en: Our attorneys reviewed the contract before the CEO signed it.
example.zh: 我們的律師在執行長簽署之前審閱了合約。

example.en: We decided to hire an attorney to review the agreement.
example.zh: 我們決定聘請律師來審閱這份協議。

example.en: You should consult an attorney before you sign this contract.
example.zh: 簽這份合約之前，你應該先諮詢律師。

example.en: The losing side must pay the attorney's fees.
example.zh: 敗訴的一方必須支付律師費。

example.en: She gave her assistant power of attorney while she was abroad.
example.zh: 她出國期間把代理權授予她的助理。

examples.en: The company attorney will explain the new terms tomorrow.
examples.zh: 公司律師明天會說明新的條款。

examples.en: Our attorney sent a letter to the supplier about the late payment.
examples.zh: 我們的律師為了遲付款項寄了一封信給供應商。

examples.en: An attorney from the firm joined the meeting by phone.
examples.zh: 事務所的一位律師以電話加入了會議。

similar.diff: lawyer 是一般用語，各國通用；attorney 在美國較正式，強調能代表客戶辦理法律事務。

example.en: We need a lawyer who knows import rules.
example.zh: 我們需要一位熟悉進口規定的律師。

similar.diff: counsel 較正式，指提供法律意見的律師或法務團隊，常指公司法律顧問。

example.en: The firm's legal counsel approved the new policy.
example.zh: 公司的法律顧問核准了這項新政策。

example.en: Both sides signed the contract on Monday.
example.zh: 雙方在星期一簽署了合約。

example.en: The company faces a lawsuit over unpaid wages.
example.zh: 這家公司因積欠薪資而面臨訴訟。

example.en: Please ask the legal department to check this form.
example.zh: 請法務部門檢查這份表格。

senses.en: a person trained to give legal advice and speak for others in court

example.en: An attorney will represent us in tomorrow's hearing.
example.zh: 明天的聽證會將由一位律師代表我們出席。

senses.en: a person who has the legal right to act for someone else
senses.distinguish: 出現在 power of attorney 或 attorney-in-fact 時，不一定是律師。

example.en: The attorney-in-fact signed the sale papers for the owner.
example.zh: 受託代理人代替所有人簽署了買賣文件。

extra_vocab.en: working by itself without a person controlling it
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於產品說明、系統功能與帳務設定，如 automatic payment、automatic update。也可形容自然的反應或理所當然的權利。

example.en: Sign up for automatic payment so you never miss a bill.
example.zh: 申請自動扣款，這樣你就不會漏繳帳單。

example.en: The contract has an automatic renewal each January.
example.zh: 這份合約每年一月會自動續約。

example.en: The automatic door opens when someone steps in front of it.
example.zh: 有人走到門前時，自動門就會打開。

example.en: I set up an automatic reply while I am on vacation.
example.zh: 我在休假期間設定了自動回覆。

examples.en: The printer has an automatic paper feed that saves time.
examples.zh: 這台印表機有自動進紙功能，可以節省時間。

examples.en: The software performs an automatic backup every night at midnight.
examples.zh: 這套軟體每晚午夜會自動備份。

examples.en: A late fee is automatic if payment is not received by the due date.
examples.zh: 若在到期日前未收到款項，就會自動加收滯納金。

confusable.diff: automated 指流程被機器或軟體取代人工，強調「被自動化」；automatic 強調機器本身會自動運作。
confusable.usage: automatic 是形容詞；automated 是 automate 的過去分詞當形容詞，常放在 system、process 前面。

example.en: The factory uses automated systems to sort packages quickly.
example.zh: 工廠使用自動化系統快速分類包裹。

example.en: Please switch to manual mode if the sensor fails.
example.zh: 如果感應器故障，請切換到手動模式。

example.en: The new machine can pack two hundred boxes an hour.
example.zh: 這台新機器一小時可以包裝兩百個箱子。

derived.link: automatic 的詞幹，動詞「使自動化」；-ate 結尾，像 create、celebrate

example.en: An automatic light turns on when someone enters the hallway.
example.zh: 有人走進走廊時，自動燈就會亮起。

senses.zh: 不經思考的、自然反應的
senses.distinguish: 形容人的反應或答案時，指「下意識的」。

example.en: Her automatic answer was yes, but she checked the schedule first.
example.zh: 她下意識的回答是好，但她先查了行程表。

senses.zh: 理所當然的、依規定必然發生的
senses.en: happening as a normal result of a rule or situation
senses.distinguish: 與 access、right、entry 等一起出現時，指「依規定一定會有」。

example.en: Members get automatic access to all training videos.
example.zh: 會員自動就能觀看所有訓練影片。

extra_vocab.en: to wait for something to happen or arrive
extra_vocab.note: 較正式的及物動詞，多益常見於公文、公告與信件，如 await your reply、payment awaits approval。常用被動或進行式 be awaiting。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: await 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，不加 for（await your reply）；wait 才需要用 wait for。

example.en: A long list of emails awaits her after the holiday.
example.zh: 假期結束後，一長串的電子郵件在等著她。

example.en: Customers awaited the new model for almost a year.
example.zh: 顧客等待這款新型號將近一年。

example.en: Three packages are awaiting pickup at the front desk.
example.zh: 有三個包裹在櫃台等待領取。

example.en: We await your reply before making a final decision.
example.zh: 我們等候您的回覆後再做最後決定。

example.en: The new budget must await approval from the board.
example.zh: 新預算必須等候董事會核准。

example.en: Customers await delivery of their orders in two to three days.
example.zh: 顧客在兩到三天內等待訂單送達。

example.en: Please await further instructions from the head office.
example.zh: 請等候總公司的進一步指示。

examples.en: Details will be sent later, so please await our call.
examples.zh: 詳細資料稍後會寄出，請等候我們的來電。

examples.en: Passengers should await boarding calls in the departure lounge.
examples.zh: 乘客應在候機室等候登機廣播。

examples.en: A busy schedule awaits the new manager on her first day.
examples.zh: 新經理上班第一天就有忙碌的行程在等著她。

confusable.diff: wait 是不及物動詞，意思相近，但後面的接法不同。
confusable.usage: wait 要接 for + 受詞（wait for the reply）；await 是及物動詞，直接接受詞（await the reply）。

example.en: Please wait in the lobby until the manager is ready.
example.zh: 請在大廳等候，直到經理準備好。

similar.diff: look forward to 帶有期待的心情，後面接 V-ing；await 只是中性地「等候」。

example.en: We look forward to meeting you at the trade show.
example.zh: 我們期待在貿易展與您見面。

similar.diff: expect 是「預期」，不一定在等；await 是正在等待某件事發生或到達。

example.en: We expect the shipment to arrive on Tuesday.
example.zh: 我們預計貨物會在星期二抵達。

example.en: I had to wait twenty minutes for the elevator.
example.zh: 我等電梯等了二十分鐘。

example.en: The payment is still pending until the bank confirms it.
example.zh: 在銀行確認之前，這筆款項仍在待處理狀態。

example.en: The team awaits the test results before making a decision.
example.zh: 團隊等候測試結果後才做決定。

senses.en: to be ready or likely to happen to someone in the future
senses.distinguish: 主詞是事物（a surprise、a challenge），受詞是人，意思是「事物等著某人」。

example.en: A great opportunity awaits those who apply early.
example.zh: 一個很好的機會正等著提早申請的人。
